issues.description: The problem statement requires the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) in Farm to be public "for easier testing", but both the template and the reference solution declare it as private. This creates a contradiction about the required access modifier and may lead students to change the method signature in a way that diverges from provided code/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and code: either (a) change Farm.singFarmSongVerse(Animal) to public in template and solution, or (b) update the problem statement to state it should be private (and ensure tests do not require public access).

issues.description: In the template, Farm.singFarmSongVerse does not declare the required parameter because it is commented out ("/*Animal animal*/"), while the problem statement and reference solution define singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This mismatch can block straightforward implementation because students must first fix the signature to accept an Animal argument.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template method signature to singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) (uncomment and import/use Animal) so it matches the problem statement and solution.
